text.text_excerpt: Yall I'm not even ashamed to admit it... I took off of work just to eat Rollin Fatties!!! Yep, sure did! Needed to start my birthday week off right and I knew the only way how was to go here ASAP. And a bummer that they are only open 11-2 on weekdays. Well let me just say I was not disappointed. Explosion of goodness is the understatement of the year. The heavens opened up and the Gastronomy gods spoke up and said YOU MUST TRY THIS FOOD TRUCK. I tried the chicken fattie which is a 12in stuffed burrito with rice, beans, chicken, red cabbage and other yumminess. But like filled to the max. This $7 burrito will have you full till next week! If you think I stopped there then you are mistaken....

So I've finally managed to get myself over to the Rollin Fatties food truck. I feel pretty guilty it's taken me so long considering I've worked about 20 steps away -right inside of the very building they park in front of almost every single day- for over a year now. BUT I now see the error of my ways, and my eyes have been opened by this amazing little food truck! Since it was my first time visiting, I decided to try the loaded nachos. When I arrived there was a bit of a line but it moved lightening fast; By the time I figured out what I wanted to order- I was up! The folks working there are really personable and treated me like I was a regular (by the way, I will be from now on I promise...

A very popular food truck, and for good reason. You can typically find them on Tulane Ave. from 11am-2pm near the hospital and medical school. (Tip: check their Instagram page to follow their location!) The menu is beautifully simple: you choose from a bowl/burrito/tacos/nachos, select a protein, and decide whether or not you want to add guacamole. They don't have the protein options written on their menu, so you need to ask the cashier, but based on my visits it seems like there's chicken, fish, and tofu. Not sure if these ever vary.
